Synthetic company introduction.

This is a full-time role that can be held from a US hub or remotely in the United States.

What you'll do at Synthetic Systems:
  • Build accessible product workflows for distributed teams.
  • Partner with product and design to deliver reliable releases.

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 5+ years technical front-end knowledge.
  • English fluency.
  • Experience supporting Go-to-Market planning.
  • Prior management consulting experience.
  • Ability to gain enterprise sponsorship for product deployments.

While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience mentoring other engineers.
  • Knowledge of design systems.

Synthetic Systems offers employees additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits with company contributions; parental leave; and paid time off.

Annual Base Salary Range:
$153,000—$376,000 USD
